tabs.html:
Ugreen US102 USB 2.0 Male to Male Cable 1.5M (Black) – Premium Quality, High-Speed Data Transfer Cable

Ugreen US102 USB 2.0 Male to Male Cable 1.5M (Black) is the ideal solution for connecting your USB devices with ease. Featuring high-quality construction and a 1.5-meter length, this durable black cable supports fast data transfer speeds and provides reliable performance. Whether you're connecting your computer, printer, scanner, or external hard drive, the Ugreen USB 2.0 cable ensures seamless connectivity. Its plug-and-play functionality allows for simple and hassle-free connections without the need for drivers. Perfect for everyday use, this versatile USB cable is designed for optimal durability and long-lasting performance.

Key Features:

  • Length: 1.5 meters
  • Color: Black
  • Supports USB 2.0 data transfer speeds up to 480Mbps
  • Durable construction for long-lasting use
  • Plug and Play design for easy connection
